column1: # member() / identicalMember() results from the reference C++ engine (libclassad), one per line:
# <tag>\t<expr>, where expr is evaluated as attribute x of
# [ A = 5; R = 5.0; B = true; S = "abc"; L = {1, 5}; N = [a = 5]; E = error; U = undefined; x = <expr> ]
# and tag is U (undefined), E (error) or B:true / B:false. The cases are every first argument in a
# set of scalars, references, a list and an ad, against every second argument in a set of literal
# lists (constants, mixed types, nested values, references, expressions) and non-lists.
